request: Power supply with 2 outputs: 5V fixed and 1-12V variable. 8x10 cm, single layer, low budget. (Answers: 12V DC adapter, 1A total, 0.5A on each rail.)

spec.summary: Dual-rail supply: fixed 5 V and adjustable 1.25-8 V from a 12 V adapter.
warnings: 1V requested; LM317 minimum is ~1.25V, so the variable rail starts at 1.25V
12V requested on the variable rail, but a 12V input leaves no headroom for a linear regulator; the variable rail is limited to 8V

plan.explanation: One 7805 for the fixed rail, one LM317 for the variable rail. A 12 V input cannot give 12 V out of a linear regulator (needs 2.5 V headroom), so the variable rail is limited to 8 V.
